project_identity.name: EVEREA TV / BIOXIC
project_identity.design_archetype: Architectural 3D Liquid Glass & Cinematic Dark Tech
project_identity.primary_emotion: Immersive, high-end broadcasting studio elegance with tactile glass depth

theme_strategy.mode: Dark Theme (Pure Deep Void + Midnight Cyan Refraction)
theme_strategy.rationale: Music streaming & 24/7 video broadcasting platforms require low-ambient distraction, high image contrast, and vibrant broadcast highlights. Dark backdrop allows glass refractions and neon live indicators to pop effortlessly.

forbidden_colors: #000000 (Flat pure black without depth or tint)

glass_system_recipes.principles: Layered translucent surfaces with explicit physical depth, high contrast text legibility, 1px specular inner borders, and subtle top lighting.

typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans / Inter (Clean Sans, High Readability)

hierarchy.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight

anti_patterns: No default Inter for main H1 titles
No transparent text on low-contrast glass

navigation_header.desktop: Fixed top horizontal glass header (height: 72px) with official white transparent logo, primary links (Acasă, TV Broadcast, Muzică, Videoclipuri, Program TV, Chat Live), user avatar/login CTA, and search bar.
navigation_header.mobile: Sticky top bar with logo & live badge + bottom glass navigation dock or sliding glass drawer.

structure: 1. Large Hero Broadcast Section (Cinematic 16:9 HLS Live Player, LIVE red pulse badge, next-premiere countdown timer, quick play/mute CTA, overlay metadata).
2. Weekly TV Schedule Bar (Horizontal scroll timeline with status indicators: În Direct, Urmează, Premieră).
3. Editorial Video Cards Grid (Responsive bento grid, 16:9 cards, play overlay on hover, track title, artist).
4. Upcoming Premieres & Countdown Cards (Glass cards with real-time countdown clock).
5. Recent Audio Tracks & Radio Stream Quick Deck.

tv_page.layout: 2-column layout on desktop (3:1 ratio). Main cinematic TV player taking 75% width with floating glass controls, advertising 2s white logo intro sequence, right column spacious live chat container.

live_chat.container: Wide central conversation column (min-width: 340px, comfortable message padding p-4). Translucent glass message bubbles with clear contrast between user and assistant/system messages. Large premium input bar with send CTA and emoji picker.

music_page.layout: Radio live stream player banner + seekable audio track list with cover artwork + synchronized lyrics interactive modal overlay.

video_hub.layout: Bento grid video library with categories, search, YouTube-style lightbox player with comments & related clips.

live_room.layout: Full-screen dark room with interactive vinyl spectrum visualizer + floating chat overlay + stream stats.

fan_login_modal.design: Centered glass panel over blurred backdrop. Email/Password inputs with sharp focus rings, Google OAuth button, white transparent logo at header.

persistent_player.position: Fixed bottom dock bar (h-20) with track artwork, play/pause, seek timeline, volume control, lyrics toggle, and minimize option.

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-400 hover:to-blue-500 text-white font-semibold px-6 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.3)] transition-all duration-300 active:scale-95
buttons.secondary_glass: bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/15 text-white font-medium px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl backdrop-blur-md transition-all duration-200

badges.live_now: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-red-500/20 border border-red-500/50 text-red-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider animate-pulse
badges.upcoming_premiere: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-cyan-500/20 border border-cyan-500/50 text-cyan-300 text-xs font-semibold

cards.video_card: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/60 border border-white/10 hover:border-cyan-500/40 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_12px_30px_rgba(0,240,255,0.15)]
cards.schedule_card: p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/40 border border-white/5 hover:bg-slate-800/60 transition-colors

micro_interactions_and_motion.hover_depth: Translate-Y -4px with glowing cyan shadow expansion on interactive cards
micro_interactions_and_motion.entrance_animation: Fade-in with slide-up y: 20px, duration 0.4s ease-out
micro_interactions_and_motion.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling parallax and heavy CSS transforms, maintaining static crisp glass panels.
micro_interactions_and_motion.performance_rule: No global mouse-move canvas listeners; use CSS transform GPU layers (will-change: transform) for high-framerate playback.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case mandatory on all buttons, links, player controls, form inputs, schedule items, chat input, and modals.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standard: All body copy must meet APCA / WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio over glass panels.

general_guidelines: All interactive elements must include descriptive data-testid attributes.
Keep site language strictly in Romanian for UI strings.
Never use pure black background without subtle depth and blue/cyan ambient glow.
Ensure video player controls remain responsive on touch devices.
